meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据 H&E 病理图的小块(224×224 像素)预测所查基因的空间表达(log1p-CPM);也能整张切片分块批量预测,输出基因表达地图。
howto.when: 当用户需要从 H&E 图像预测空间基因表达(log1p-CPM)、按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或要求对整张切片分块后批量预测时触发。

say.text: 分析这张 H&E 病理图,预测 EPCAM 和 CD3D 的表达量。
say.note: 会返回这两个基因在该位置的空间表达值(log1p-CPM)。

say.text: 把这张切片切成 224×224 的小块,预测全切片基因表达。
say.note: 会按网格分块批量预测,并拼成整张切片的表达地图。

say.text: 用 scgpt 嵌入源查询 TP53 和 CD8A 的表达。
say.note: 选用不同基因嵌入来源后查询指定基因。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take a small tile (224x224 pixels) from an H&E histology image and predict spatial expression of queried genes in log1p-CPM units. It can also tile a whole slide and run batch prediction to produce a gene expression map across the tissue.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs spatial gene expression (log1p-CPM) from H&E images, wants to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or wants to run whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Analyze this H&E histology image and predict expression of EPCAM and CD3D.
say_en.note: Returns spatial expression in log1p-CPM for those genes.

say_en.text: Tile this slide into 224x224 patches and predict whole-slide gene expression.
say_en.note: Tiles slide, runs batched prediction, maps gene expression.

say_en.text: Query TP53 and CD8A using the scgpt embedding source.
say_en.note: Switches the gene embedding source before querying.
